answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring nodes to bond native tokens, turning the network into an island of economic accountability. Like cooling basalt that hardens a foundation, staking prevents attackers from creating infinite identities because every new node incurs a capital cost. To extract nectar from the system, adversaries must deploy significant wealth, ensuring that the cost of an attack outweighs the potential yield of malicious participation.
